review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer - Artificial Lift
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Present and propose the full range of ALS solutions to customers based on their operational requirements. Diagnose operational and technical issues and provide effective troubleshooting solutions. Review tender documents and prepare clarification requests to address technical and commercial requirements before submission deadlines. Maintain and update a tender and quotation tracker, covering deadlines, bid bonds, submission status, and win/loss records. Ensure a smooth handover
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Responsibilities Present and propose the full range of ALS solutions to customers based on their operational requirements. Review tender documents and prepare clarification requests to address technical and commercial requirements before submission deadlines. Ensure a smooth handover of awarded contracts and orders to the operations and delivery teams, with clearly defined scopes and technical requirements. Required Minimum of 5 years of experience in Artificial Lift Systems (ALS), including at least 3 years in operations and 2 years in sales. Hands-on experience in ALS technologies, including pumping units, sucker rod pumping systems, PCP, and jet pumps. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, Communications/Electronics Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
